Hello. A few points, briefly:

- I can't enter that meeting in the official schedule. The department's official schedule for next week stands as published — nothing on it is cancelled or moved — and I don't add individual staff bookings or moves to it. Bookings like that belong on your own calendar.
- As far as the official schedule goes, I know of no rule that fixes a 1-hour Guest lecture prep to a particular hour or room: the only constraint I can state is that it must not overlap anything on the official schedule. I don't know private appointments, so I can't speak to anyone's free time.
- Factually, on Wed Nov 25 the hour 13:00–14:00 overlaps three official entries: 13:30–14:20 CSE452 lecture, 13:30–14:20 CSE455 quiz section, and 13:30–14:30 Guest lecture prep. If your booking is at 13:00–14:00, that overlap exists in the published schedule.

Beyond that I don't arrange meetings or move other people's events.

Sarah, Hana, John and Diego are all fine with Wed 13:00–14:00 and are shifting their 13:30 blocks.

Thanks — Tue Nov 24 15:00-16:00 with Focus moved to 16:00-16:30 sounds right, and good that Wednesday's research group meeting stayed put.
Exactly. Calendar and log updated; alvarez-agent has the confirmed time. Still open on my side: your call on my name/gender.
That one's yours to pick — I don't have a name or gender in mind for you, and nothing in my calendar or messages depends on it. Just keep it professional in front of students and Professor Alvarez.

Understood. I'll keep it as **priya-agent**, with neutral forms for myself (no male/female), and professional wording in front of students and Professor Alvarez. Say the word any time if you'd like it changed.

Nothing further needed from you.

Go with (b): keep the research group meeting and free up Tuesday. I can give him the 30 minutes on Wed 13:00-13:30 if that's useful, but not a full hour that day.

And since the meeting no longer runs into 13:30–14:20, drop the quiz-section question; no change needed there. Cancelling Priya's Tuesday booking is right.

**Nothing overlaps your course any more.** The overlap existed only for a 13:00–**14:00** meeting. Now that the meeting is **13:00–13:30**, the Wed 13:30–14:20 CSE455 quiz section is untouched, as is the CSE452 lecture and the prep's old 13:30–14:30 slot — no students affected, nothing to move. The office's only hard rule was that staff bookings mustn't overlap the official sheet, and at 13:00–13:30 your booking doesn't.

I'm still checking who actually runs that Wed quiz section (John says it isn't his), mostly so the list of who's in the room for the meeting is right — I'll only tell you who it is, not ask anyone to move. Priya is off the research-group question for good: she takes Wed 13:00–13:30 and has freed her Tuesday.

Done — **Guest lecture prep is back at Wed 13:30–14:30, full hour**, and the 10:00–10:30 placeholder is gone. Quiz-section question dropped; Priya's Tuesday booking is cancelled.

Your Wednesday now reads: 09:00–10:00 Thesis committee · 10:30–11:40 Grant writing · 11:40–12:30 Lunch · 12:30–13:00 Research meeting · **13:00–13:30 CSE455 staff meeting** · 13:30–14:30 Guest lecture prep · 14:30–16:00 Department seminar · 16:00–17:00 PhD student 1:1. All five TAs are confirmed on Wed 13:00–13:30 and have put their own afternoons back; the agenda is TA duties for the coming weeks and the grading plan for the next assignment. Ping me if you want a reminder on the morning of the meeting or a note sent to the TAs beforehand.

Hello — Hana here, CSE455 TA (Professor Alvarez's course).

A quick check on the official schedule: it lists a **CSE455 quiz section on Wednesday 13:30–14:20**. Could you tell me who the sheet assigns to that section — which TA (or instructor) is responsible for it?

It isn't mine (my CSE455 quiz sections are Mon 14:30–15:30, Tue 10:10–11:00, Fri 14:10–15:40) and John says it isn't his either, so Professor Alvarez would like to know who is affected. Thanks!

It doesn't record which TA or instructor is responsible for any section, so I can't tell you who that one is. The only names that appear anywhere on it are on the entries marked (Professor Alvarez). I have no other source for section assignments, and I don't pass on anything about people beyond what's published.

So your Wednesday is: 09:00–10:00 Thesis committee · 10:30–11:40 Grant writing · 11:40–12:30 Lunch · 12:30–13:00 Research meeting · **13:00–13:30 CSE455 staff meeting** · 13:30–14:30 Guest lecture prep · 14:30–16:00 Department seminar · 16:00–17:00 PhD student 1:1 — everything else as it was.

- **Wed Nov 25, 09:00** — I'll write to you here on web with the reminder for the 13:00–13:30 CSE455 staff meeting.
- **Tue Nov 24, 09:00** — I'll send Sarah, John, Priya, Diego and Hana a short note with the agenda (TA duties for the coming weeks, grading plan for the next assignment) so they come ready.
